promise: Bring the Kigali Amendment phasing down HFCs into force on 1 January 2019
description: Adopted in Kigali in October 2016, the Kigali Amendment to the Montreal Protocol commits parties to phase down hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) by more than 80% over 30 years. The ratification threshold of 20 parties was reached on 17 November 2017, and the amendment entered into force on 1 January 2019 as scheduled, with more than 150 parties ratifying in the following years.
evidence: Entered into force on 1 January 2019 after 20 ratifications in November 2017
Projected to reduce HFC-driven warming by 2100 from 0.3-0.5°C to under 0.1°C
Over 150 parties ratified within years of entry into force
